name: extra_v1
description: RAGAS Answer Accuracy and Factual Correctness, DeepEval Summarization and Hallucination, on saved answers. Not part of the official GraphRAG-Bench protocol.

judge.note: The operator chose Claude Haiku 5.5 on Bedrock if it is available; it needs an AWS Marketplace subscription that the bedrock profile does not have (2026-10-10), so the official judge is used.

metrics.label: Factual Correctness (RAGAS)
metrics.note: One claim decomposition and verification in each direction; precision, recall and F1 come from the same TP, FP and FN, with the formulas of FactualCorrectness.

metrics.label: Summarization (DeepEval)
metrics.note: The original text is the gold evidence, the same for every system. The assessment questions are made once per question by `score_extra.py prepare` and used for every system.

metrics.label: Hallucination (DeepEval; higher is better)
metrics.note: Context is the gold evidence, one context item per fact. The score is the fraction of facts that the answer does not contradict, so "I don't know" scores 1.
